# Spice Village Catering

> Authentic South Indian catering in Dublin, Ireland — weddings, corporate events, birthdays, Holy Communions and family gatherings. Over 16 years and 5,000+ events catered.

## Key facts
- Cuisine: South Indian / Kerala (starters, appam, paratha, idiyappam, biryani, curries, desserts)
- Event types: weddings, corporate events, birthday parties, family gatherings, outdoor catering, Holy Communion, special occasions
- Branches: Clondalkin (main, Dublin 22), Lucan (Dublin 22), Rialto (Dublin 8), Naas (Co. Kildare)
- Opening hours: Monday–Sunday, 9:00am–10:00pm
- Phone / WhatsApp: +353 85 818 9052
- Email: info@spicevillagecatering.ie
- Custom menus available for any event size or dietary requirement
